lemari.1: Lemari kubuka sedikit. Bau tanah basah masih menempel.
lemari.2: Jejak kaki di lantai kayu masih ada. Dari kamar ke pintu belakang.
lemari.3: Sudah kuberhapus tadi malam. Pagi ini muncul lagi.

jendela.1: Jendela kubuka selebar tangan. Udara malam masuk, dingin.
jendela.2: Dari arah hutan, ada yang memanggil namaku. Pelan dan jelas.
jendela.3: Aku tutup jendela. Panggilan itu tidak datang dua kali.

ponsel.1: Layar ponsel menyala. Angka utang masih di situ.
ponsel.2: Pesan dari nomor pinjol masuk lagi. Isinya cuma ancaman basa-basi.
ponsel.3: Aku letakkan ponsel telungkup. Angkanya tetap terbaca di kepalaku.

pesan_rudi.1: Mas, ada orang nanya gua soal malem itu.
pesan_rudi.2: Gua bilang nggak tau. Tapi kok jadi panas, ya.
pesan_rudi.4: Raka bicara dengan Rudi siang tadi. Sekarang Rudi gelisah.

kasur.1: Aku berbaring. Lampu kamar mati. Langit-langit berubah jadi ladang.
kasur.2: Ladang itu terbakar, tapi apinya tidak panas. Yang panas bisikannya.
kasur.3: Joy berdiri di ujung. Aku tidak bisa memanggilnya.

menoleh.1: Aku menoleh. Ia sudah ada di belakangku, dekat sekali.
menoleh.2: Mataku terbuka. Kipas langit-langit berputar pelan. Cuma mimpi.

tidak.1: Aku terus menatap depan. Bisikan itu makin jauh.
tidak.2: Mataku terbuka. Keringat di pelipis. Cuma mimpi.

cermin.1: Cermin di lemari memantulkan kamar yang gelap.
cermin.2: Napasku menguap di kaca. Padahal kamar tidak dingin.
cermin.3: Aku bergeser. Cermin tidak ikut bergeser sepersekian detik.

pintu.1: Dua ketukan di ambang pintu. Pelan, lalu beri jeda.
pintu.2: Suara Raka dari balik sana: 'Bang, kau belum tidur?'
pintu.c2: Biarkan terbuka. Aku jawab ketukan itu.

kunci.1: Gerendel kucerahkan. Suara klik keras di malam yang sunyi.
kunci.2: Aku tidak menjawab. Suara Raka berhenti di luar pintu.
kunci.3: Pintu terkunci. Malam ini aku sendiri.

buka.1: Aku geser gerendelnya. Pintu kumundurkan sedikit.
buka.3: Suaraku serak. Raka diam sejenak, lalu langkahnya menjauh. Aku menjawabnya.

b14.cari: Find the source of the sound in your room
b14.pintu: Settle the matter of your bedroom door

lemari.1: I open the wardrobe a little. The smell of wet soil still clings.
lemari.2: The footprints on the wooden floor are still there. From the room to the back door.
lemari.3: I wiped them away last night. This morning they came back.

jendela.1: I open the window a hand wide. The night air comes in, cold.
jendela.2: From the forest, someone is calling my name. Slow and clear.
jendela.3: I close the window. That call does not come twice.

ponsel.1: The phone screen lights up. The debt number is still there.
ponsel.2: Another message from the loan shark number. Only polite threats.
ponsel.3: I lay the phone face down. The number stays printed in my head.

pesan_rudi.1: Mas, someone was asking me about that night.
pesan_rudi.2: I said I don't know. But why did it get tense.
pesan_rudi.3: Don't tell anyone yet, Mas. Please.
pesan_rudi.4: Raka talked to Rudi this afternoon. Now Rudi is restless.

kasur.1: I lie down. The room light goes out. The ceiling turns into a field.
kasur.2: The field is burning, but the fire is not hot. The whispering is hot.
kasur.3: Joy stands at the far end. I cannot call out to her.
kasur.c1: Turn around to look for her.

menoleh.1: I turn. She is already behind me, very close.
menoleh.2: My eyes open. The ceiling fan turns slowly. Only a dream.

tidak.1: I keep looking ahead. The whispering moves further away.
tidak.2: My eyes open. Sweat on my temples. Only a dream.

cermin.1: The mirror on the wardrobe reflects the dark room.
cermin.2: My breath fogs the glass. The room is not even cold.
cermin.3: I shift. The mirror does not shift with me for a split second.

pintu.1: Two knocks on the door frame. Slow, then a pause.
pintu.2: Raka's voice from the other side: 'Bang, are you still awake?'
pintu.c2: Leave it open. I will answer the knock.

kunci.1: I slide the latch shut. A hard click in the quiet night.
kunci.2: I do not answer. Raka's voice stops outside the door.
kunci.3: The door is locked. Tonight I am alone.

buka.1: I slide the latch open. I push the door back a little.
buka.2: It is fine, Ran. I am going to sleep.
buka.3: My voice is rough. Raka is quiet for a moment, then his steps move away. I answered him.
